anatomical_image.desc: Structural *intensity* image, typically T1. If more than one anatomical image is specified, subsequently specified images are used during the segmentation process. However, only the first image is used in the registration of priors. Our suggestion would be to specify the T1 as the first image.

b_spline_smoothing.desc: Use B-spline SyN for registrations and B-spline exponential mapping in DiReCT.

brain_probability_mask.desc: brain probability mask in template space

brain_template.desc: Anatomical *intensity* template (possibly created using a population data set with buildtemplateparallel.sh in ANTs). This template is  *not* skull-stripped.

debug.desc: If > 0, runs a faster version of the script. Only for testing. Implies -u 0. Requires single thread computation for complete reproducibility.

extraction_registration_mask.desc: Mask (defined in the template space) used during registration for brain extraction.

image_suffix.desc: any of standard ITK formats, nii.gz is default

label_propagation.desc: Incorporate a distance prior one the posterior formulation.  Should be of the form 'label[lambda,boundaryProbability]' where label is a value of 1,2,3,... denoting label ID.  The label probability for anything outside the current label = boundaryProbability * exp( -lambda * distanceFromBoundary ) Intuitively, smaller lambda values will increase the spatial capture range of the distance prior.  To apply to all label values, simply omit specifying the label, i.e. -l [lambda,boundaryProbability].

out_prefix.desc: Prefix that is prepended to all output files

posterior_formulation.desc: Atropos posterior formulation and whether or not to use mixture model proportions. e.g 'Socrates[1]' (default) or 'Aristotle[1]'. Choose the latter if you want use the distance priors (see also the -l option for label propagation control).

prior_segmentation_weight.desc: Atropos spatial prior *probability* weight for the segmentation

quick_registration.desc: If = 1, use antsRegistrationSyNQuick.sh as the basis for registration during brain extraction, brain segmentation, and (optional) normalization to a template. Otherwise use antsRegistrationSyN.sh (default = 0).

segmentation_iterations.desc: N4 -> Atropos -> N4 iterations during segmentation (default = 3)

t1_registration_template.desc: Anatomical *intensity* template (assumed to be skull-stripped). A common case would be where this would be the same template as specified in the -e option which is not skull stripped.

use_floatingpoint_precision.desc: Use floating point precision in registrations (default = 0)

use_random_seeding.desc: Use random number generated from system clock in Atropos (default = 1)
